name: Pirates Of Islets
author: Addicting Games
description: Pirates Of Islets is a free shooting game based on the pirates of the sea! Hop on board and join Pirates Of Islets as they go on an adventure to find gold and potions. This a brightly colored online game full pirates, gold, ships, and so much more! Your character hops from wheel to wheel as you collect gold and other boosts. Be wary of any bombs or other dangerous objects that you must avoid else you lose the game. Crash through treasure chests and collect as much gold as you can. Use your gold to unlock helpful boosts, cool character skins, and backgrounds. Collect 40,000 coins to unlock all of the trophies that this online game has to offer. Get as far as you can each time, and then view your scores on the leaderboards. If you’re not where you want to be, then play again, unlock everything, and climb up the leaderboards!
